scenes.text: Every day, pet owners lose precious hours to a dog that slipped the gate.
One lost dog becomes a hundred doorbells to knock on. And every hour, she gets further away.
Then the question changes. What if the complicated part simply happened?
Meet Find My Dog. Two neighbours' clips become a ranked match, while you stay in control.
Behind that moment, SAM 3.1 tracks every animal, and Muse Spark matches on appearance. Not magic. Working software.
So you can get back to the walk home.
Find My Dog. Bring them home.
